additional_info.subject: 0385791 - ID0385791-DC/Si-D/BE-[Multi] FW Rollback CRM:00472000236
additional_info.body:
Hello Marnic,
I have downgraded all chargers from Sparki together with Francisco, except one.
FTnJCz is still on v5.0.21.
We tried to downgrade it 2 times already, but we face issues with router XF4 in both attempts. The router firmware in Sicharge D FW v5.0.21 is different from v4.0.11, during the rollback it was not possible to downgrade, even manually forcing it.
This mismatch of the router firmware leads to the charger booting in failsafe mode on FW v4.0.11.
I'm checking with R&D if it's possible for them to do the router downgrade otherwise we will need to replace this router.
I will bring you news hopefully next Monday.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
mailto:joao.louro-cardoso@siemens.com
www.siemens.com

additional_info.subject: 0385791 - ID0385791-DC/Si-D/BE-[Multi] FW Rollback CRM:00472000236
additional_info.body:
Hi Marnic,
Please be aware of the “ghost sessions” where the SECC loses connection. If the backend doesn't charge money for the time spended then it should be fine, but you will need to reboot the charger if the session is stuck. You should see the session ongoing with Target values but no Now values.
If that's the case then I will close the ticket, if you need anything just ping me in Teams.
Best regards,
Francisco
